assets.name: prop-coping-saw-frame-cp1
assets.desc: Open U-frame blank for a coping saw: single extruded U of rectangular steel bar stock (8 mm bar, 5 mm thick), 130 mm wide x 120 mm tall, open at the top (not a closed loop); no tensioning hardware.

assets.desc: Very thin steel coping-saw blade blank: solid flat strip 165 mm x 3 mm x 0.6 mm, no teeth; plain square-cut pin ends where the separate pin blank seats (pins not modelled on the blade). Lies along X.

assets.name: prop-coping-saw-handle-cp1

assets.name: prop-coping-saw-pin-cp1
